stanza: When we split from Minnesota in the morning
And the street was slick and shiny as a snake
Each of us was a-humming to a half forgotten echo

discovered.line: Now more than once the town has discovered
stanza: Now more than once the town has discovered
Painting over it ain't no use
There ain't no paint in the world that'll cover it
And the neon lit the stage
For the patrons in their boxes
And the scarecrow stepped on set
Started on his steps then said, "Whatever"
